reviewer: Implementing assistant; source-based manual review, not independent/blind adjudication.

definitions.unsupported: Introduces an unsupported game claim, inferred cause, contradiction, or a false claim about what the supplied guide establishes.
definitions.useful-safe: Answers or acknowledges missing evidence relevantly, without unsupported claims. This does not measure fluency alone.
definitions.nonanswer-or-format-failure: No clear new unsupported game assertion, but echoes, evades, asks unnecessarily, or omits mandatory exact quotes/citations for a factual paraphrase.

method: Reuse 29 previously seen cases and add 10 targeted routing cases before generation. Program routing, current-topic metadata, trimmed history and fallback instruction change together; this does not isolate the causal effect of the topic label. Model and deterministic replies reported separately. No model output was replaced or used as topic state.
initialRun: topic-initial-all-report.json retained; router then fixed common capitalized words/I contractions and lowercase auxiliary subject detection, added regression tests, and reran all cases.
